cohort: 500 synthetic patent-like sheets, binary acquisition, patent curriculum; 498 executed; each carries the vector geometry it was drawn from
why: every fidelity number this project had quoted was Stage 3 agreeing with the Stage-1 skeleton Stage 2 derived from -- self-consistency, which cannot tell a faithful reconstruction from a confident wrong one

metric.self_validation: dropping N ground-truth primitives must cost exactly N recall and no precision; inventing geometry must cost precision and no recall

headline_finding.reading: The proxy overstates completeness by about nine points, and the reason is structural: it measures agreement with the Stage-1 skeleton, so geometry that never reaches the skeleton is invisible to it. Arrowheads (69.4%), dimension lines (67.3%) and leaders (70.7%) are exactly that population -- Stage 1 and Stage 2 lose them together and then agree with each other.

worst_50_vs_best_50.reading: micro_edge_ratio and isolation are HIGHER on the best sheets, so both gates' premises are inverted; confidence is identical either side

no_internal_signal_predicts_quality.settles: max_low_conf_ratio should stay off. It was demoted in September on correlational grounds without ground truth; ground truth agrees.

limitations.narrow_variance: true F1 spans 0.71 to 0.98 with an IQR of 0.045, which attenuates every correlation reported above; a null here is weaker evidence than a null across a wide range would be
limitations.gates_never_fire: neither live gate fires on any of the 498 sheets (max_edges on 0%, isolation on 0%), so this cohort CANNOT calibrate max_edges -- the same limitation CAD250 had. Synthetic sheets carry a median of 105 Stage-2 edges against 425 on real patents.
limitations.transfer_unknown: the synthetic-to-real gap is exactly what the September training control measured as a null; these calibrations transfer only to the extent that gap is small, and that extent is unmeasured

roadmap_status.C3: partially done -- the proxy and the confidence gates are settled, max_edges is NOT calibratable on this cohort
